home.blurb: Computer Engineering graduate and software developer with backend internship experience at Hyper Company. Builds AI-powered full-stack platforms and scalable systems with ASP.NET Core, Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design.

projects.name: PECS: Prompt Engineering Competency Assessment Platform
projects.description: LLM-powered prompt engineering competency assessment platform, built as a capstone project with a teammate. Integrated Google OAuth 2.0 and JWT authentication, and optimized EF Core queries with AsNoTracking and AsSplitQuery to improve the LLM integration layer.

projects.name: Hotel Business Website
projects.description: A modern, responsive hotel website template designed for small and medium-sized hotels. Features room showcases, image galleries, WhatsApp booking integration, inquiry forms, Google Maps location display, and mobile-first design. Built with a focus on increasing direct customer inquiries and creating a professional online presence.

projects.name: DepremKit
projects.description: Mobile application offering machine learning-based personalized emergency kit recommendations for earthquakes and disasters. Built for the Digital Earthquake Hackathon, where it won 2nd place.

projects.name: CDC Data Pipeline System
projects.description: Implemented a Change Data Capture system with automated synchronization between SQL and NoSQL databases with low latency and reporting capabilities.

projects.name: Hotel Management System
projects.description: Team-based project implementing a hotel management system using MVC architecture with full CRUD operations and MongoDB integration.

projects.name: RepoFlow
projects.description: Hybrid Project Management and Version Control System built with Clean Architecture, featuring secure authentication and modular backend design.

responsibilities: Built an AI-powered full-stack recruitment platform using ASP.NET Core 9, SQL Server and Angular

Developed an end-to-end resume processing pipeline covering PDF/OCR extraction, Gemini and Ollama integration, data normalization and candidate deduplication by email/phone; tested the services with xUnit and Moq
Optimized LLM-based candidate matching with a ProfileContext structure built during ingestion, cutting token usage per query by 80% while preserving matching quality
Designed and built the backend architecture of a platform combining issue tracking and file versioning with ASP.NET Core and EF Core, following Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design principles
Developed a Git-like versioning system based on the Myers Diff algorithm that stores only file changes, optimizing PostgreSQL storage usage and enabling code review support
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based authorization with Keycloak, and a real-time notification layer with SignalR; refined design decisions through feedback from weekly code reviews

experience.role: Computer Vision Developer – Teknofest Autonomous UGV Project
responsibilities: Developed real-time computer vision algorithms with Python and OpenCV; contributed to communication between Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano and sensors, obstacle avoidance and mission integration
